Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: pixel-art CHARACTER ANIMATION spritesheet for an existing game.
Input image 1 is the definitive CHARACTER IDENTITY, ART STYLE, SIZE and COSTUME reference for Vanessa and her small white Chihuahua Jerry. These SAME two characters must appear together in every frame. Preserve Vanessa's exact bob haircut shape and warm brown hair with copper highlights, large friendly brown eyes, tiny subtle side-labret piercing and small earrings as visible in the reference, black jacket over a white top, blue jeans, white/gray sneakers, black backpack with small brown clasp. Preserve Jerry's tiny cream-white short-haired Chihuahua body, very large triangular pink-inside ears, small black eyes and nose, curved tail and reddish dark collar. Jerry must remain a Chihuahua, not a fluffy dog. No new accessories or costume changes.
CRITICAL SIZE: output canvas EXACTLY 1086 pixels wide by 1448 pixels tall, the SAME dimensions as the reference. It is a STRICT 3-column by 4-row grid: TWELVE cells, every cell EXACTLY 362x362 pixels, no gutters or outer margin beyond alpha padding WITHIN each cell. No drawn grid lines, numbers, captions or labels.
Keep Vanessa's standing visible height approximately 320 pixels as in the reference. Jerry's standing full height INCLUDING ears is approximately 140 pixels, matching the reference's proportion. Maintain the exact same scale, head/body proportions, pixel-block size and palette in every cell. No enlarged portraits, chibi proportion redesign, detail increase or shrinking between frames. Each pair fits entirely in its cell with visible transparent margins and no clipped hair, ears or feet.
Anchor the pair to the same local ground baseline at y=340 within every 362x362 cell. Vanessa's planted feet center is around local x=170 and Jerry stands beside her at local x=284. The woman and dog do NOT translate over the sheet or walk. Preserve their locations from cell to cell except tiny intentional gestures. Crisp pixel-art shapes matching the reference's rendering. Actual fully transparent alpha everywhere around characters, no ground, shadows, room, scenery, text, watermark or checkerboard.
DIRECTIONAL LAYOUT: each ROW is ONE direction, consistent with the reference. Row 1 faces FRONT/toward the viewer; row 2 faces LEFT; row 3 faces RIGHT; row 4 faces BACK/away from viewer. All THREE columns within a row keep exactly that body's direction. Vanessa and Jerry's relative arrangement stays the same as that reference row. Do not rotate or mirror between columns. Show the full pair in every cell.
Create a quiet INACTIVE / IDLE loop, not walking. Every Vanessa pose has both feet planted side by side, arms relaxed, backpack motionless. Every Jerry pose stays beside her with paws planted. COLUMN 1: neutral upright stance, eyes open, Jerry neutral tail. COLUMN 2: Vanessa blinks gently and breathes in with only a 1-pixel upper-body/chest rise; Jerry blinks and his tail moves slightly to one side. COLUMN 3: Vanessa's eyes open again and breathing settles, Jerry opens his eyes with tail slightly to the other side. On the BACK row no eyes are drawn, simply the tiny breathing/ear-tail movement. Head and hair should not jump or bob several pixels. Changes are tiny and anatomically coherent, so the three frames loop with a calm pause between cycles. No raised walking knees, footstep pose, broad waving or extra character. Preserve the reference standing size.

assets.editPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: an existing 1086x1448 transparent Vanessa-and-Jerry idle-look spritesheet, THREE columns by FOUR rows, twelve complete paired poses.
Make ONLY a spacing/framing correction. Preserve the exact 1086x1448 canvas and Vanessa's exact approximately 320px standing height. Preserve Jerry's current small size, ears, paws, collar and tail shape. DO NOT SHRINK, enlarge or redesign either character.
In every LEFT-facing and RIGHT-facing row cell, move Jerry approximately 18 pixels CLOSER to Vanessa so every part of his ears and curled tail remains completely inside his own 362x362 cell with at least 10 pixels of transparent horizontal margin. The far-right cell in the second row currently clips a tiny part of Jerry's tail at the outer image boundary: restore that complete tail. Move only Jerry horizontally; keep his paws on the same baseline. In the affected rows apply the same closer spacing in all three columns, so he doesn't slide during the idle animation.
Preserve all of Vanessa's poses, expressions, clothing, hair, face, earrings, tiny labret and backpack exactly as shown. Preserve all four row directions FRONT, LEFT, RIGHT, BACK and the three-phase look-down-at-Jerry gesture in each row. Other cells remain unchanged.
Maintain each Vanessa's planted foot location. Fully transparent background, same pixel style, no added background, captions, gutters, frame borders, shadows or objects. Keep the entire subjects visible without crossing neighboring cell boundaries. The one requested edit is Jerry's horizontal placement and complete tail framing, not changing scale.
